Horizontal.note: A visible border-coloured rule between a Role block and a Team block, with even space either side. Clearly distinct from Divider's empty space.

Vertical.note: Three vertical rules between inline meta items; the row sets h-5 so they render at full height instead of collapsing.

BetweenRows.note: Repeated between index rows, it reads as a ruled list without any border utility on the rows themselves.

Combined.note: Horizontal rule under the heading, vertical rules splitting a three-stat strip at h-10. Both orientations proven in one true composition.
